verse.verse_1: Nun. By the pen, and all that they write!
verse.verse_2: By the grace of your Lord, you are not a mad man.
verse.verse_3: Most surely, you will have a never ending reward.
verse.verse_4: For you are truly of a sublime character.
verse.verse_5: Soon you will see, as will they,
verse.verse_6: which of you is a prey to madness.
verse.verse_7: Your Lord knows best who has fallen by the wayside, and who has remained on the true path.
verse.verse_8: Do not give in to the deniers of truth.
verse.verse_9: They want you to make concessions to them and then they will reciprocate.
verse.verse_10: Do not yield to any contemptible swearer of oaths,
verse.verse_11: or to any defamer or one who spreads slander,
verse.verse_12: or to one who places obstacles in the way of good being done or to the wicked transgressor,
verse.verse_13: who is ignoble and besides all that, base-born;
verse.verse_14: just because he has wealth and sons,
verse.verse_15: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, "These are just ancient fables."
verse.verse_16: Soon We will brand him on the nose.
verse.verse_17: We have tried them as we tried the owners of a certain orchard, who vowed to harvest all its fruits the next morning,
verse.verse_18: without saying, "If it be God's will."
verse.verse_19: A calamity from your Lord befell the orchard as they slept.
verse.verse_20: And by morning it lay as if it had already been harvested, a barren land.
verse.verse_21: So they called out to each other at the break of dawn,
verse.verse_22: saying, "Be quick to reach your orchard, if you want to gather all your fruits."
verse.verse_23: So they went off, whispering to one another,
verse.verse_24: "Be sure to stop any poor person from entering the orchard today."
verse.verse_25: They set out early in the morning, thinking they had the power to prevent.
verse.verse_26: But when they saw it, they said, "We must have lost our way.
verse.verse_28: The more upright of the two said, "Did I not bid you to glorify God?"
verse.verse_29: They said, "Glory be to God, our Lord. We have surely done wrong."
verse.verse_30: Then they began to heap reproaches on each other.
verse.verse_31: They said, "Alas for us, our behaviour was beyond the pale.
verse.verse_32: May be our Lord will give us a better orchard in its stead; we turn to Him."
verse.verse_33: Such was their punishment, [in this life]. But the punishment of the life to come is much more severe, if only they knew it!
verse.verse_34: Those who are mindful of their Lord will be rewarded with gardens of bliss.
verse.verse_35: Should We treat the true believers and the wrongdoers alike?
verse.verse_36: What ails you? How ill you judge!
verse.verse_37: Have you a Scripture that tells you
verse.verse_38: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
verse.verse_39: Or do you have Our solemn oaths, binding upon Us till the Day of Resurrection, that you shall have whatever you yourselves decide?
verse.verse_40: Ask them, which of them will vouch for that!
verse.verse_41: Or have they other partners [besides God]? Let them bring forth their other partners, if what they say be true.
verse.verse_42: On the Day when the truth shall be laid bare, they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, but they will not be able to do so.
verse.verse_43: Their eyes will be cast down and they will be covered in shame; they were bidden to prostrate themselves, when they were safe and sound [but they did not obey].
verse.verse_44: So leave to Me those who reject this message. We shall lead them step by step to their ruin, in ways beyond their ken.
verse.verse_45: I shall grant them some respite, for My plan is powerful.
verse.verse_46: Do you demand some recompense from them that would weigh them down with debt?
verse.verse_47: Is the unseen within their grasp so that they write it down?
verse.verse_48: Wait patiently for your Lord's judgement; do not be like the man who, having been swallowed by a whale, called out in distress.
verse.verse_49: Had his Lord's grace not been bestowed upon him, he would have been cast away in disgrace upon that desolate shore.
verse.verse_50: But his Lord chose him for His own and made him one of the righteous.
verse.verse_51: When those who deny the truth hear the admonition, they would almost cause you to stumble with their evil eyes; and they say, "He is certainly mad."
verse.verse_52: Yet it is purely an admonition to mankind.
